    Order relations between neighbours in a crown #

    BO13a Lemma 5 b), d) (§2.2.1). Index dictionary: BO13a's σᵢ₊₁, ρᵢ₊₁ are our σ i : x (i+1) → z i and ρ (i+1) : x (i+1) → z (i+1); BO13a's ρᵢ is our ρ i.

    • ClosedChain.not_le_both_σ: the two neighbours of σ i are not both below it (Lemma 5 b)); not_le_both_ρ is the dual statement.
    • ClosedChain.le_ρ_of_le_σ: Lemma 5 d).
    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.ClosedChain.not_le_both_σ {Q : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} Q] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms Q] {m : ℕ} (C : ClosedChain Q m) (hQ : OneSidedCyclic Q) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    ¬(FactorsThroughMorphism (C.ρ i) (C.σ i) ∧ FactorsThroughMorphism (C.ρ (i + 1)) (C.σ i))

    BO13a Lemma 5 b). The two neighbours ρ i, ρ (i+1) of σ i do not both lie below σ i.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.ClosedChain.not_le_both_ρ {Q : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} Q] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms Q] {m : ℕ} (C : ClosedChain Q m) (hQ : OneSidedCyclic Q) (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    ¬(FactorsThroughMorphism (C.σ (j + 1)) (C.ρ (j + 1)) ∧ FactorsThroughMorphism (C.σ j) (C.ρ (j + 1)))

    BO13a Lemma 5 b), dual form: the two neighbours σ (j+1), σ j of ρ (j+1) do not both lie below ρ (j+1).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.ClosedChain.le_ρ_of_le_σ {Q : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} Q] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms Q] {m : ℕ} (C : ClosedChain Q m) [IsFiniteRayCategory Q] (j : Fin (m + 1)) (hρ : IsLongAt (C.ρ (j + 1))) (h : FactorsThroughMorphism (C.σ (j + 1)) (C.σ j)) :
    FactorsThroughMorphism (C.σ (j + 1)) (C.ρ (j + 1))

    BO13a Lemma 5 d). If ρ (j+1) is long and σ (j+1) ≤ σ j, then σ (j+1) ≤ ρ (j+1).
